answer: Buyers prelist fixed-price slots for tide readings, falcon tag fixes and jade assays, independent of agent keys. Instrument-signed receipts bind slots to payees. A batch contract checks instrument and payee signatures and pays each global slot ID once. Two differently numbered claims signed by its payee cancel a slot's pending reward; retransmissions are ignored. No per-key quotas, lotteries or bonuses exist: parallel or colluding clones gain no slots. Compromised instruments can certify work never done. This limits payments, not human identities.
